title: Median-to-mean in the browser: validation of the allmeta median-to-mean app against R
description: Validation archive for the allmeta median-to-mean app (allmeta v1.10.0, https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24515927): app snapshots with SHA-256 sums, pre-registration, seeded corpus, Node.js harness, captured outputs of the original and corrected pages, R reference scripts and the one-command check `Rscript validate.R`.
